promotion_gate.local_holdout_limitation: No production-local holdout is available; local scoring remains shadow/offline only.
promotion_gate.predeclared_rule: For an external-only authority change: require a valid manifest-bound artifact, exact non-overlapping held-out membership proof, chronological windows, at least 0.80 coverage, and no more than 0.15 all-case Top-1 regression against the incumbent. For a local-authority change: additionally require clean production_live external-source evidence.

leakage_controls: whole sessions remain in one recorded chronological split
the external artifact is fixed and never rebuilt from evaluation sessions
each local shadow window uses only complete sessions before that window
all compared models receive identical case identities per window
